description: A budget whose cost quota is 0 is spent: the task's first checkpoint reports a CostBudget cancel (Cx::checkpoint, cx.rs:3145) and, the task going on, it ends Cancelled(CostBudget). A cost quota of 0 together with a spent poll quota ties at the same severity, so PollQuota stays; a nonzero cost quota never cancels (no task-level charge exists in Rust). A child spawned in that poll inherits the spent quota: its first checkpoint reports the cancel too, it returns at once, and it ends Ok with no cancel reason on its record.
